title: General Aptitude Mock Test
description: Quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning and verbal ability — the format used by bank, SSC and campus placement exams.
instructions: The test has 3 sections and 17 questions. You can switch sections at any time.
Each correct answer earns +4. Each wrong answer costs −1 unless stated otherwise.
Multiple-correct questions in Logical Reasoning award partial marks when every option you pick is correct.
Only answers saved with “Save & Next” or “Save & Mark for Review” are evaluated.
The test submits automatically when the timer reaches zero.

questions.text: A shirt is sold for ₹1,200 after a 20% discount. What was its marked price?
questions.solution: Selling price = 80% of marked price, so marked price = 1200 ÷ 0.8 = ₹1,500.

questions.text: What is the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹8,000 at 6% per annum for 3 years?
A 240 m long train passes a pole in 12 seconds. What is its speed?
A can finish a job in 10 days and B in 15 days. How long will they take working together?
questions.solution: Combined rate = 1/10 + 1/15 = 1/6 of the job per day, so 6 days.

questions.text: If 3x + 7 = 25, what is the value of x?
A sum of money doubles in 5 years at compound interest (compounded yearly). What is the annual rate of interest, in %? (Answer to 2 decimal places.)
If CODE is written as DPEF, how is LAMP written in that code?
questions.solution: Each letter moves one place forward: L→M, A→B, M→N, P→Q.

questions.text: Which of the following numbers are prime? (Select all that apply.)
questions.solution: 21 = 3 × 7 and 33 = 3 × 11 are composite; 23 and 29 are prime.

questions.text: Pointing to a man, Riya says, “His mother is the only daughter of my mother.” How is the man related to Riya?
questions.solution: The only daughter of Riya's mother is Riya herself, so the man's mother is Riya: he is her son.

questions.text: Which one is the odd one out?
questions.solution: All the others are quadrilaterals (four sides).

questions.text: Statements: All roses are flowers. All flowers are plants. Which conclusions definitely follow? (Select all that apply.)
questions.solution: Roses ⊂ flowers ⊂ plants gives (a); (b) and (d) follow by conversion. (c) reverses the second statement and does not follow.

questions.text: Choose the word closest in meaning to METICULOUS.
questions.solution: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail — careful.

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to SCARCE.
questions.solution: Scarce means in short supply; the opposite is abundant.
Accommodate has a double “c” and a double “m”.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: “She has been working here ____ 2019.”
questions.solution: Use “since” with a point in time and the present perfect continuous.

questions.text: What does the idiom “break the ice” mean?

options.text: To start a conversation in an awkward situation
To make a sudden loud noise

questions.solution: To break the ice is to ease initial tension, typically by starting a conversation.
